task.description: Implement DSL-10 context resolution in Zig. Identifier expressions (e.g., order.total) must resolve against context map; unresolved identifiers return typed null without error. Acceptance: zig build && zig build test both exit 0.

result.summary: Implemented DSL-10 context resolution: completed Context struct with put/get methods in ast.zig; updated evaluator dot_path handling in mod.zig to use new API; added 13 comprehensive tests covering initialization, lookup, null propagation, scalar traversal, and multi-type support. All builds pass with zero error-set warnings.
